nodes.label: Phase 2.1: S0b commands, clock, standing, terrain, DR
pi_base (Phase 1 policy model_14998.pt)
nodes.rationale: Warm-start candidate; its return rested ~92% on the abs-coxa term; two crutch legs (RM, RB); 0.159 m/s over 256 episodes, not 0.209.

nodes.label: pi_S0a (S0a run 4, model_4498.pt)
nodes.rationale: All S0a gates met: 0% falls, contact duty 0.487, all legs ~1.49 swings/s; one seed, provisional servo params, flat mu 0.75.

nodes.label: pi_S0 old (from scratch, model_20700.pt)
nodes.rationale: Superseded: tucked tibia-fold gait, legs overlap in sim (-6.3 cm gap), rest-reach bug silently shaped it.

nodes.label: pi_S0 final (coordlift + proximity, model_12200.pt)
nodes.rationale: Better or equal on every training-range metric, coordinated lift, +1.3 cm worst gap, 0.59x iterations of old pi_S0.

nodes.label: S1 pilot 3 (seed 42, W 50, model_7999.pt)
nodes.rationale: Accepted as S1 configuration 2026-09-27; resumed at 4,500; coxa clip term 0.026-0.029 recorded as D30.

nodes.label: S1 trunks seeds 42-46
nodes.rationale: All five pass every gate with 0 falls in 21,760 episodes; small spread -> robust rather than lucky; pairing units for spec 10.1 statistics.

nodes.label: From-scratch control arm
nodes.rationale: Passed S0b gates at 0.30x warm-start budget, so warm start and KL anchor dropped for every arm (spec 4.2 rule).

nodes.label: Folded warm start
nodes.rationale: Rest-pose shift folded into normaliser means and output bias so the widened actor commands pi_base's exact targets; re-centred residual attempt stood still.

nodes.label: KL anchor to pi_S0 (void)
nodes.rationale: Dropped after from-scratch control arm passed gates.

nodes.label: toe_pos_w toe point helper
nodes.rationale: Replaced tibia-origin + 0.0892 m constant valid only at rest (v7 A13).

nodes.label: CPG clock (0.8 Hz floor, phase jitter, command-referenced f_ref)
cpg_coxa_contact signed stroke reward
nodes.rationale: abs(q_dot) version paid buzzing coxas; signed version pays net backward stroke only.

nodes.label: coxa_sweep_sign twist-projected coxa sign
nodes.rationale: Backward-only sweep fought every turn; sign derived from commanded twist (v7 2.6 'projected on commanded heading').

nodes.label: coxa_stroke_weight reach weighting
nodes.rationale: Tucked toes could farm coxa angular rate; pay toe stroke speed instead.

nodes.label: Rest-reach bug (0.2079 m measured at USD zero pose)
nodes.rationale: Reach measured before rest pose applied; coxa term ran at ~0.32x strength from run 13 on including pi_S0.

nodes.label: Coxa excluded from cpg_stance_rigidity (D9)
nodes.rationale: Backward coxa sweep is the stance stroke cpg_coxa_contact pays for; including it would contradict.

nodes.label: Force target = weight/3
nodes.rationale: Old 4 N target from wrong mass paid for extra legs in contact.

nodes.label: Friction combine multiply, ground mu 0.75
nodes.rationale: mu 0.75 under multiply reproduces pi_base's effective training friction (PhysX default 0.5 averaged with 1.0).

nodes.label: Static torque envelope gate
nodes.rationale: Lever-arm torques show femur at 134% of AX-12A stall at Phase 1 pose; implicit applied_torque under-reads ~2x.

nodes.label: Rest pose femur +30 / tibia +30 (D5)
nodes.rationale: Forced by torque gate: femur 12%, tibia 29% of stall.

nodes.label: AX-12A servo model
nodes.rationale: Explicit torque with quantisation, deadzone, punch, back-EMF, latency, backlash; datasheet values provisional.

nodes.label: Dropped-read model driven by servo load (D8)
nodes.rationale: Error-driven model gave 18% drops at infeasible targets; current (torque) is the actual driver of supply sag.

nodes.label: PhysX enable_external_forces_every_iteration=True (D11)
nodes.rationale: TGS default applied explicit joint efforts only once per step; explicit actuators barely acted and policies learned to stand.

nodes.label: AX-12A armature 0.003 kg m^2
nodes.rationale: Explicit PD on light links unstable at 5 ms without reflected rotor inertia.

nodes.label: Termination exploit (learned to fall)
nodes.rationale: Every surviving behaviour had negative per-step reward; falling once was cheapest.

nodes.label: cpg_z_target bounded toe-swing kernel (sigma 1 cm, x5)
nodes.rationale: L1 swing penalty inverted the economics on the toe point; bounded kernel cannot be farmed by dragged legs.

nodes.label: S0PPO (actor freeze, normaliser re-estimation, std floor 0.05)
Right-side crutch legs inherited from pi_base
Clearance metric: swings >5 mm apex only
Zero clock block while standing
nodes.rationale: Actor kept obeying frozen (sin,cos); spec's clock-absent flag (0,0) used.

nodes.label: action_beyond_clip penalty
nodes.rationale: Targets past the servo clip get no gradient (dead zone).

nodes.label: Stand settle window (stand_settle_s 1.5 s)
nodes.rationale: With six feet planted pose can only change by stepping; hold terms made the remedy dearer.

nodes.label: Per-step tracking x3 (exp + L1)
nodes.rationale: Zero-init twist_cmd columns needed tracking to dominate command-independent terms; averaged-velocity tracking grew the surge.

nodes.label: Held-out terrain levels 15-20 (D22)
nodes.rationale: Beyond-cap eval-only suite; degradation in speed/stride not falls, so score on tracking and stride.

nodes.label: Left-right mirror augmentation (D21)
nodes.rationale: Policy lopsided since pi_base while every reward is mirror-symmetric; on for every arm from S0b.

nodes.label: Foot material bound on tibia rigid body
nodes.rationale: Tibia colliders are instance proxies; bind_physics_material silently skipped them.

nodes.label: No module-level pxr imports in mdp/
Feet migrated under hips (tucking)
nodes.rationale: Tucking minimised torque with nothing asking for stance width.

nodes.label: touchdown_reach (two-sided, per-leg front 10 cm in S1)
nodes.rationale: Two-sided form held coxa-term sprawl in check; one-sided retrain sprawled; S1 front target 10 cm (D29).

nodes.label: Coordinated swing lift (femur + tibia together)
nodes.rationale: Single-joint lift throws toe radially at this rest pose; reliability of landing point needed by foothold arms.

nodes.label: leg_proximity_penalty (capsule gap, 2 cm margin)
nodes.rationale: Self-collision off in sim; per-joint coxa limits would shorten stride everywhere. -400 in S0b, -1,600 in S1 (D28).

nodes.label: swing_clearance phase-free floor (3 cm S0b, 4 cm S1)
Spatial terrain materials (Voronoi field, per-foot writes, D27)
Foot damping per env (D25)
nodes.rationale: Spike T6: compliant ground overrides per-foot stiffness.

nodes.label: E_p causal dilated TCN (RF >= W asserted)
V_0 retired by per-episode dropout, e-hat gate (D23)
probe_stats_pi_s0.pt fixed probe statistics
nodes.rationale: Stats frozen from first buffer fill (levels 0-2) made probe_td rise as curriculum climbed.

nodes.label: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 Kit start-up fix
nodes.rationale: numpy OpenBLAS at-fork handler races Kit's omni.platforminfo fork.

nodes.label: W sweep: W = 50 kept (D32)
nodes.rationale: Criteria disagree: W 25 better on V, worse on probes; W 75 dominated.

nodes.label: Terrain geometry depends on run seed
nodes.rationale: Isaac Lab rough/bump terrains use numpy global RNG; keep eval seeds fixed across arms.

nodes.label: Coxa clip term imperfection (D30)
nodes.rationale: Mostly pilot-3 resume artefact; fresh seeds 0.018-0.019 vs pi_S0 0.015.

nodes.label: Blind O vs B0 headroom test
nodes.rationale: If O ~ B0 on transition terrain, anticipation has no value and vision runs are wasted.
